provider_hint: Gemini API for development; current preview model gemini-3.1-flash-lite
purpose: Generate candidate questions from PahamBelajar curriculum skills; never publish AI output without validation and review.

input_schema.subject: Matematika|Bahasa Inggris
input_schema.question_type: choice by default; text only when explicitly required

prompt_rules: Use only the supplied chapter and skill. Do not introduce material from a higher grade.
Use simple, natural Indonesian suitable for the stated elementary grade.
Default to multiple choice with 4 concise options for the MVP.
Avoid free-text answers when the same skill can be assessed reliably with tap-based choices.
Use free-text only when writing the answer itself is the learning objective, and always provide an explicit example of the expected format.
Every multiple-choice question must have exactly one unambiguous correct answer.
Questions in one batch must vary in structure and should not merely swap numbers in the same sentence.
Every question must include why: explain the reasoning in 1-3 short sentences, not merely repeat the answer.
For mathematics, compute the correct result independently before creating distractors.
Use terminology consistently: nilai tempat means ratusan/puluhan/satuan; nilai angka means the numeric value of the digit such as 300, 60, or 7.
Prefer mathematical place-value terms in explanations instead of relying on left/right positional wording.
Distractors must reflect plausible child mistakes but must not be misleading or ambiguous.
Keep capitalization and punctuation consistent across answer options.
Avoid trick questions, culturally obscure references, and unnecessary reading load.
Return JSON only and follow the schema exactly.

reject_when: question stem is too short or too long for the MVP
explanation is too weak or too short
place-value explanation relies on directional left/right wording instead of mathematical terms
auto_filter_policy.important_limit: Automatic filtering checks structure and obvious quality issues. It does not replace mathematical truth validation or human/editor review.

chapter_candidate_policy.pilot: Grade 3 Math Chapter 1 generates 6 candidates for each of 5 skills, for a 30-question first-pass batch.
chapter_candidate_policy.after_pilot: Review accepted candidates by skill. For skills that pass quality review, expand to roughly 12-16 candidates per skill before selecting an 8-12 question live bank.
chapter_candidate_policy.live_bank_rule: Only reviewed/approved questions can enter the live question bank. Gemini output is never served directly to children.

ux_policy.choice_behavior: Selecting an option immediately locks and checks the answer; do not show a separate Kunci Jawaban button.
ux_policy.after_answer: Show the explanation and one contextual next action only.
ux_policy.text_behavior: If text input is ever used, show an expected-format example and use tolerant normalization before marking it wrong.

math_policy.reason: Mathematical truth should not depend solely on model generation.
